description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android foreground service named NodeForegroundService, which manages the connection status of an OpenClaw node. It handles notifications, lifecycle events, and interacts with the NodeRuntime for real-time status updates and connectivity management.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android foreground service that maintains a persistent connection to an OpenClaw node, updates notifications with connection status, and handles start/stop commands.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: A data class used to encapsulate five elements of runtime status data for notification updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, creates notification channel, and launches a coroutine that observes runtime status, updating foreground notifications accordingly.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles service start commands, including stop action, and manages the service lifecycle accordingly.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing coroutines and cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as this is a started service, not a bound service.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates the notification channel if it does not already exist.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification with a given title and text, including actions for launching the app and stopping the service.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates the current foreground notification with new content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the service in the foreground, or updates the notification if already started.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Static method to launch the foreground service.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Static method to stop the foreground service.
